implemented_families.moesi_multi_private_data_clean: multiple read-only private D-cache sharers, no I-cache sharers, shared=true, LLC-backed or non-LLC local-sharer form
implemented_families.moesi_private_instruction_only: instruction-only private sharers, no D-cache sharers, shared=true, LLC-backed or non-LLC local-sharer form
implemented_families.moesi_single_private_data_clean: one read-only private D-cache sharer, no I-cache sharers, shared=true, LLC backed
implemented_families.moesi_single_private_data_writeable: one writable private D-cache owner, no I-cache sharers, shared=false, in_shared_cache=false, LLC absent

known_unimplemented_families.anything_else: any private coherent block family that does not match the current implemented or explicitly named unsupported MOESI families
known_unimplemented_families.multi_private_data_clean_mixed_instructi: multiple read-only private D-cache sharers plus private I-cache sharers
known_unimplemented_families.private_instruction_only_directory_nonsh: instruction-only private sharers with directory shared=false
known_unimplemented_families.single_private_data_clean_mixed_instruct: one read-only private D-cache sharer plus private I-cache sharers
known_unimplemented_families.single_private_data_clean_nonllc: one read-only private D-cache sharer, no I-cache sharers, shared=true, LLC absent
known_unimplemented_families.single_private_data_writeable_directory_: one writable private D-cache owner, no I-cache sharers, but directory metadata still claims shared or in-shared-cache
known_unimplemented_families.single_private_data_writeable_llc_backed: one writable private D-cache owner, no I-cache sharers, LLC backed
known_unimplemented_families.single_private_data_writeable_mixed_inst: one writable private D-cache owner plus private I-cache sharers
